name: Everything In The Room
hint: Four takes. Three jobs need holding down and you have one body per take. Plate p2 (x=4..6) takes the turret offline; the perch at x=9.8..12.2 pins walker w1 at the LEFT end of its x=8..20 span; plate p1 (x=18..20.2) opens the door at x=24. TAKE 1: walk right onto p2 and stand. w1 crowds to its left bound at x=8 but cannot reach x<8, so you are safe two units away. TAKE 2: Echo A holds p2, so the turret stays dark. Climb the step at x=7..9.2 (1.8 rise) and up onto the perch at x=9.8 (2.4 rise) and stand — w1 gathers underneath and cannot reach you. TAKE 3: Echo B on the perch now holds w1 pinned near x=10, but that is exactly where you would have to walk, so go over it instead: climb the same step and perch, hop the 0.4 gap onto the catwalk at x=12.6..18.6, run right along it above the walker's head, and drop off its end onto p1 at x=18. Stand. TAKE 4: p2 holds the turret dark, the perch holds w1, p1 holds the door open from about t=2.4s. Take the catwalk one more time, drop at x=18.6, and run right — doorway at x=24, exit at x=34, through a lane the turret can no longer fire down and past a walker that is watching someone else.

dialogue.text: A gun, a guard, and a door. One of you each.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Three standing still so the fourth can walk. You are getting used to it.
That is the part that worries me.
